description: Latest readings of four individual Bitcoin cycle indicators (MVRV Z-Score using a 4-year moving-average proxy, Risk Metric, 200-week moving average rate of change, Pi Cycle Bottom ratio), each with a percentile zone from the full price history and its own date, plus the latest BTC price in AUD and USD. Use this when the user asks about a specific on-chain or valuation indicator or wants the components behind a cycle view; use get_cycle_model_reading for the combined 48-signal score. Daily and monthly indicators are mixed, so check each reading's date. USD price is derived from AUD at the daily AUDUSD rate and can differ from global USD quotes by 1-2%.
name: get_cycle_indicators
title: Bitcoin cycle indicators
